acceptance_status: Automated-inventory checkpoint; full functional/native/manual/performance/release parity remains open.
scope: Rust ToolsForm now decides tools command/IME admission, recording transitions and action outcome presentation. Rust also projects history empty/error/count/More and clear-busy controls; native browser commands, validation, authorization and service operations remain authoritative.

build_input_snapshot.gn_delta: No target/dependency change. Rust bridge adds clear_selection for existing SelectState. Explicit native adapters, preference selector allocation/refresh and browser tests changed. Concurrent root network-policy work remains excluded.
build_input_snapshot.method: Frozen UI overlay base a3afc206f742f0a59da6e65d609ddf1df3c7326d plus 16 explicit live UI overrides (including sidebar_metal.h/mm), with committed own installer/stager hooks; concurrent network-policy changes excluded. Twenty-one prototype source hashes are matched to committed, live and staged inputs.

native_service_patch.license: Generated Chromium header and source hook retain the Chromium BSD-style license; project adapter/tool/model changes use Apache-2.0.

contracts: Twelve existing form command IDs cross with field-presence, composition and selection-validity facts only. Native widget visibility and posted workspace/profile/generation checks remain before dispatch; actual native object/index bounds, browser stores, GURL/provider/shortcut validation and command execution remain in C++. Rust returns a UI command ID or failure; no native object, URL, profile handle or service authority crosses this new dispatch ABI.

Rust preserves the original composition gate for snapshot save, shortcut save/disable and provider actions. Record remains admitted during shortcut preedit so the native adapter cancels composition before making the field readonly. Other commands retain their original composition behavior. Non-record actions cancel recording before command execution; repeated Record still synchronizes native input state.

Rust action outcomes decide whether to reconstruct the form and select the original generic/shortcut/provider error or done/pending copy. Native operation_pending is still queried after successful reconstruction, matching the original order. Successful sleep retains its early native return. Native disk-write and external service status notifications remain adapters.

Rust projects history empty-profile/no-search-results/read-error text, displayed count/retry status and More visibility/enabled state from admitted results. Completed errors may retain rows while hiding/disabling More, as in Views. Current committed query is already owned by Rust; native profile/query/limit admission and actual service data remain unchanged.

The native browsing-data busy flag remains service-owned and shared with preferences. Rust supplies the history clear-button caption/enabled projection both during busy changes and reconstruction. Preferences clear-button behavior remains native. Existing cross-page busy/rebuild tests remain in the gate.

Three new Rust cases cover command/composition/context admission, recording/repeated-record transitions, all page outcomes, history count/error/More combinations and clear-busy controls. A new shared browser case verifies real failed provider/shortcut saves without state mutation/reconstruction, recording during IME and Escape recovery, empty profile/filter/error/result status and More behavior, including nonempty errors. Existing Cocoa success, IME/stale-action, history clearing/paging, scene/scroll and browser-service tests remain covered.

No rendering recipe, crate/library/dependency, native platform permission, store or service operation is added or replaced. Provider/shortcut option-to-field projection, remaining service/progress wording and outer/native interaction ownership remain to migrate.

optional_scenarios.status: Not rerun for this presentation checkpoint. The earlier tools-chrome report retains four default-30-trial passes per backend; none is counted as a current-commit pass.

limits: Remaining provider/shortcut option-to-field/form construction coordination, popup/empty-item/service/progress wording, native row/list/event/focus/AX/scroll and outer container ownership, other forms and browser-service panels remain open. Native service busy state, validation, confirmation, authorization, stores and operations remain explicit adapters.
Manual IME/candidate-window, VoiceOver, complex bidi/RTL, typography/scale, pointer/trackpad, detach/reattach and GPU recovery acceptance remain open.
No controlled CPU/GPU/drawable-presentation speedup or memory improvement is claimed.
Normal installed applications/profiles were untouched; no release bundle was packaged/signed. Final shipped-binary Apache-2.0/upstream license/notice acceptance remains open.
